title: Canyonlands National Park Backcountry 4x4 Adventure from Moab
overview: Discover the rugged beauty and ancient legends of Canyonlands National Park on a 4WD tour from Moab. Go off-roading in a sturdy Jeep to reach the Island in the Sky district and other remote areas, where the Colorado River slices through steep ravines and ancient Pueblo rock art decorates the sandstone cliffs. Hold on tight as your driver and guide navigates the switchbacks of Shafer Trail, and fill your camera roll with amazing perspective shots of the red-rock canyons.
startDescription: 378 N Main St, Moab, UT 84532, USA — meeting point next door to Comfort Suites; large pipe statue of a man holding an oar in front of parking lot. Ends at meeting point. Hotel pickup/drop-off not included (office contact for private pricing).
notes: Operator Adrift Adventures. Live H1: Canyonlands National Park Backcountry 4x4 Adventure from Moab. Shared (not private); max 12. Catalog card also shows from $210 / 4.9 (422). Strong Island in the Sky / Shafer Trail half-day jeep cornerstone.

title: Canyonlands National Park Needles District by 4x4
overview: Hit the dusty trail on a 4x4 tour of Canyonlands National Park. Expert guides will take you to see the highlights of Utah’s Chesler Park such as Elephant Hill, Devil’s Lane, and Devil’s Kitchen. There’s also the option to take a 3-mile (4.8-km) hike on the spectacularly scenic Joint Trail. This full-day adventure is the perfect way to experience Utah’s backcountry away from the crowds.
inclusions: Hotel pick-up and drop-off (depending on location)
startDescription: NAVTEC Expeditions, 321 N Main St, Moab, UT 84532, USA. Depart ~8:00 am for Chesler Park / Needles District. Pickup offered; ends at meeting point. ~2-hour drive to Needles.
notes: Operator NAVTEC Expeditions (authorized concessionaire). Park entrance fees excluded ($15/person unless parks pass). Optional Joint Trail hike. Min 3 travelers. Best Needles-district portfolio slot (not Island in the Sky).

title: Canyonlands National Park White Rim Trail by 4WD
overview: Go off-roading by 4-wheel drive (4WD) deep into Canyonlands National Park via the White Rim Road, a scenic route of switchbacks and red rock formations. This full-day tour with an expert guide includes popular spots such as Island in the Sky, Gooseneck overlook, Musselman Arch, Lathrop Canyon and the Shafer Trail leading to the Colorado River. Take short optional guided hikes that lead to hidden passages, secret canyons and the caves of Canyonlands. Buffet lunch and round-trip transport from Moab included.
startDescription: NAVTEC Expeditions, 321 N Main St, Moab, UT 84532, USA. Depart 8:00 am (arrive 15 minutes early). Pickup offered; ends at meeting point.
notes: Operator NAVTEC Expeditions. USD listing cards show from US$337 / USD 336.96; AU locale dump showed A$535.50. Park entrance fees excluded. Likely to Sell Out on some surfaces. Longer White Rim immersion vs half-day Shafer products. Price from Viator en-AU dump FromUSD 336.96.

title: Island in the Sky of Canyonlands Helicopter Tour
overview: Soar above the Canyonlands and enjoy thrilling aerial views with this 45-minute scenic helicopter flight from Moab. Enjoy a birds-eye view and capture stunning photos of highlights such as the Deadhorse Point, Thelma and Louise Point,, the Colorado River, Behind the Rocks, and backcountry canyonlands such as Corona, Pritchett, Funnel Arch, and Halls Bridge.
inclusions: Headsets to clearly hear the narration
All taxes, fees and handling charges
startDescription: 94 W Aviation Way, Moab, UT 84532, USA — inside Canyonlands Field Airport Terminal. Ends at meeting point.
notes: Operator Redtail Air / Pinnacle Helicopter family. Catalog card title Island in the Sky of Canyonlands Helicopter Tour; URL slug Edge-of-Canyonlands-Helicopter-Air-Tour. Hero from attraction listing card (360x240; 674x446 path not confirmed on page dump). Likely to Sell Out. Small group (aggregator max ~3). Hero upgraded to verified 674x446.

title: Canyonlands Full Day Private Tour and Hike
overview: Join Master Naturalist guides for a full-day private tour and hike focused on Canyonlands National Park. The itinerary stops at natural arches and sandstone formations, with time for off-the-beaten-path features when conditions allow. Guides share the park's human and geological history along with flora and fauna context throughout the day.
inclusions: Gourmet picnic lunch (dietary requests with notice)
startDescription: Pickup offered (operator pattern: within ~90 minutes of park / Moab lodging). Price varies by group size. Private — only your group participates.
notes: Operator Good Trip Adventures. Catalog: from $973, 5.0 (2), 8 hours, price varies by group size. Aggregator mirrors also show ~$972.95 and duration 6–8 hours. Thin review count. Canyonlands-specific SKU (distinct from Canyonlands/choice 265766P8). Hero upgraded to verified 674x446.

title: Colorado to Canyonlands Geology Airplane Tour
overview: Discover Canyonlands National Park from the air and learn more about the geology of the Colorado Plateau with this airplane tour. Take off from Moab and fly over the mountains, canyons, rivers, and surrounding landscape of Southeastern Utah and Western Colorado, with informative commentary from your pilot along the way.
itineraryStops: Confluence of the Colorado and Green Rivers
inclusions: Headsets to clearly hear the narration
All taxes, fees and handling charges
startDescription: Canyonlands Regional Airport / Canyonlands Field Airport, Moab, UT (94 W Aviation Way pattern for Redtail family). Sold by group size, not per seat; starting price up to 3 guests.
notes: Operator Redtail Air. Catalog Likely to Sell Out. Charter-style pricing ($1,156 for up to 3). Only 1 review on attraction card — thin social proof. Strong geology/education air differentiation. Hero upgraded to verified 674x446.

title: Unique Secluded Sunset In Moab: Canyonlands by 4x4 & Hike
overview: Private small-group sunset experience combining a short bumpy 4x4 ride (including Long Canyon Road ascent) with a ~0.5-mile scramble hike to a secluded Canyonlands vista away from crowded overlooks. Start time varies 4:00pm–5:45pm with sunset. Lots of picture stops. Operator Moab In A Day.
inclusions: Private tour for your group only
startDescription: 150 E Center St, Moab, UT 84532, USA. Pickup from hotels/campgrounds/Airbnbs within Moab city limits; outlying lodges meet at office. Private — max ~4 guests. Park entry excluded ($15/person or free with valid pass for up to 4).
notes: Live H1 renamed vs URL slug (Sunset Scenic Tour of Canyonlands…Dead Horse). Duration triangulated from aggregator mirrors (~3.5h); confirm on partner API. Dead Horse in URL/slug; live bullets emphasize secluded Canyonlands sunset via Long Canyon rather than classic Dead Horse Point overlook.

title: Sunrise photography in Dead Horse Point and Canyonlands National Park
overview: Perfect your photography skills while exploring Dead Horse Point State Park and Canyonlands National Park. You and your photographer guide will head out in time to catch the early morning light. Your guide will also be available to teach you about composition and help you navigate your camera's settings while you work sunrise light across Island in the Sky overlooks and canyon rim viewpoints.
startDescription: Moab Information Center, 25 E Center St, Moab, UT 84532, USA. Meet one hour before sunrise outside visitor center (closed at arrival). Room for 4–5 passengers; larger groups may carpool. Park admission excluded — bring pass.
notes: USD listing from**US$250** / price varies by group size. CA locale showed From CA$357.02. Optional Canyonlands full-day extension.
